airport.name: Cam Ranh International Airport / Cam Ranh Air Base

summary: Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) serves as the main gateway to the popular beach resort city of Nha Trang on Vietnam's south-central coast. Originally developed as a military air base during the Vietnam War, the facility was converted for civilian use and has since grown into one of Vietnam's busiest airports, featuring both international and domestic terminals. Its dual military-civilian status and coastal location make it distinctive among Vietnamese airports.
faqs:
Q: How far is Cam Ranh Airport from Nha Trang city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 30-35 km south of Nha Trang, with a typical taxi or shuttle ride taking 45-60 minutes depending on traffic.

Q: Does Cam Ranh Airport have international flights?
A: Yes, the airport operates both domestic and international flights, with the new international terminal serving routes to destinations across Asia and some charter services from Russia, China, and South Korea.

Q: Are there currency exchange and ATM services at the airport?
A: Yes, both currency exchange counters and ATMs are available in the terminal buildings for converting foreign currency to Vietnamese Dong.

Q: Is the airport shared with a military base?
A: Yes, Cam Ranh Airport shares facilities with a Vietnamese Air Force base, reflecting its origins as a former U.S. and Soviet military installation.
transport_tips: Taxis and ride-hailing services are readily available outside the terminals, though travelers should agree on a fare or use metered taxis to avoid overcharging. Shuttle buses run between the airport and Nha Trang city center at scheduled intervals, offering a budget-friendly alternative. Private transfers and hotel-arranged pickups can be pre-booked for added convenience, especially during peak tourist season.
local_tip: Visit the nearby Cam Ranh Bay area for fresh seafood restaurants that most tourists miss—locals know this stretch has better prices and more authentic Vietnamese dishes than the busier spots in central Nha Trang.
